title: My Best Friend
body:
Sarah is my best friend. We have been friends for five years. We met at school when we were eight years old. Now we are thirteen, and we do almost everything together.

Sarah is very kind and funny. She always listens to me when I have problems. She gives me good advice and makes me laugh when I feel sad. I can trust her with my secrets because she never tells anyone.

We have the same interests. We both like reading books, watching movies, and playing sports. Every weekend, we go to the library together and borrow new books. After school, we often play basketball in the park.

Sometimes we have small arguments, but we always say sorry and forgive each other quickly. True friendship means accepting each other's differences and being loyal to your friends.

I'm very lucky to have Sarah as my best friend. She makes my life better and happier every day.

essays.q: Who is your best friend? Why is this person special to you? Write 3-4 sentences.
essays.sampleAnswer: My best friend is Jimin. She is very kind and always helps me when I have problems. We have known each other for three years. I feel happy whenever I am with her.
essays.rubric: ① 친구 이름 언급 ② 특별한 이유 1가지 이상 설명 ③ 문장 3개 이상 완성된 형태로 작성 ④ 문법 오류 최소화

essays.q: According to the passage, what do Sarah and the writer do together? Write about two activities using complete sentences.
essays.sampleAnswer: Sarah and the writer read books and watch movies together. They also play basketball in the park after school every week.
essays.rubric: ① 본문에서 언급된 활동 2가지 이상 제시 ② 완전한 문장으로 작성 ③ 본문 내용과 일치 ④ 철자/문법 정확성

essays.q: In your opinion, what makes a true friend? Explain using your own ideas, not just the passage.
essays.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, a true friend is someone who listens to you and never judges you. A true friend also keeps your secrets and supports you during hard times. I think trust is the most important part of friendship.
essays.rubric: ① 자신의 의견을 명확히 제시 ② 근거나 예시 포함 ③ 본문을 단순히 베끼지 않고 자기 언어로 표현 ④ 3문장 이상 논리적으로 연결

essays.q: Describe a time when you and your friend had an argument. How did you solve the problem?
essays.sampleAnswer: Once, my friend and I argued about a game. We didn't talk for one day. Then I said sorry first, and we became friends again. Now we laugh about it together.
essays.rubric: ① 구체적인 다툼 상황 서술 ② 해결 과정 설명 ③ 시제 일관성 (과거시제) ④ 4문장 이상

essays.q: The passage says 'True friendship means accepting each other's differences and being loyal to your friends.' Do you agree or disagree? Explain why.
essays.sampleAnswer: I agree with this idea. Every person is different, so good friends should accept those differences instead of trying to change each other. Also, being loyal means staying with your friend even in difficult times. That is why I think this sentence is true.
essays.rubric: ① 찬성/반대 입장을 명확히 밝힘 ② 이유 2가지 이상 제시 ③ 본문 인용구를 참고하되 자신의 언어로 설명 ④ 문장 간 논리적 연결어 사용
